prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find and grab object, check properties and move to new location. If object missing, scan area. Go!     list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToNewLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToNewLocation
	END
